ops.body: Stage-B integration review requirement from the scheduler API: its MetaStamp equality skips Capturer entirely. Inventory must therefore detect worktree-only edits (including unstaged edits and new nonignored files) even when the Claude transcript/index/HEAD are unchanged. A transcript-only or .git-metadata-only stamp loses manual/editor changes and paused-agent WIP. Add an E2E fixture that edits code without appending transcript data and observes a new checkpoint at the next tier interval. Avoid solving this by a recursive node_modules scan. Also preserve the approved configurable tier intervals; current scheduler.Config exposes only workers/scan/coalescing.
